title: Convertible Bonds: Advancing Electronic Trading
summary: How is electronic trading reshaping the convertible bond market? In this interview, Cameron Williams, European Equity Product Management at Tradeweb, discusses the trends transforming the market. From evolving liquidity and client behaviour to automation, portfolio trading and the next phase of market innovation, he shares his insights into the forces shaping execution today.
